text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, our challenge in the 
Twinkle Series with Special Week finally 
begins!
choice_data_list:
I swear I'll make Spe's dream come 
true...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pumped with enthusiasm, we first headed to 
the cafeteria to grab lunch, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp!! Hmm, wonder if I can fit a little 
more...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee, refills please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you're adding even more?! 
That amount... it's measured in tons, not 
kilos anymore! It's on a whole other 
level—no, a whole different unit!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
This is bad! Not only is the pantry 
completely empty... even the fresh produce 
brought straight from the academy's fields 
is already gone...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was strangely noisy inside. On top of 
that, a mysterious crowd had gathered...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, you're getting another refill? 
You always eat a lot, but this is even 
more than usual."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... J-Just looking at it is starting to 
give me heartburn.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, that mountain of plates... I can't 
even see her behind it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seems like the crowd's growing, and it's 
turning into quite an event~. Nyahaha.
choice_data_list: (What the heck is going on here...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing instinctively toward the center 
of the crowd, past towering piles of 
countless stacked plates—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —*Gulp!!* Ngh, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could we get two more of the 
same, please?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah! Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Trainer, I'm sorry for startling 
you earlier!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, when I realized that today marks 
the start of my true challenge in the 
Twinkle Series... I just...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't sit still!! It's like this 
fighting spirit is blazing up deep in my 
gut, whoosh-whoosh!!
choice_data_list: So that's why you were eating so much...?
So that's why you were eating so much...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, my energy is fully replenished!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, o-of course I'll burn it all off 
properly during training, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I definitely want to avoid a massive 
weight gain right from day one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Burning off the energy she just consumed 
would require an absurd amount of 
training, but... I decided to keep that to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get right into 
training...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's right! Before that, there's 
something I wanted you to see.
choice_data_list: Something you want to show me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is... a letter from my mom. Addressed 
to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inside, written with utmost care, was 
gratitude for training their daughter, 
along with a heartfelt plea: 'Please, 
support her dream...'"
choice_data_list: She's a great mom, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes. She's my mom, and I'm proud of her!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why—I want to become the 
'Number One Umamusume in Japan!'

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For both the mom who raised me, and the 
mom who gave birth to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand tall and show them how 
proud and respectable I've become...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!! First, aiming for the Make Debut...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you, 
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began our days together with 
Special Week, striving to become the 
"Number One Horse Girl in Japan"!
